full_prompt_en: A square fantasy oil-style painting shows a stout bearded warrior standing on a rocky ledge inside a cavern glowing orange-red. The upper background is a rough wall of firelit stone, its recesses dark brown and its ridges bright with warm light. The warrior occupies the center, viewed from slightly below with one boot planted forward and the body turned toward the right. Thick pale hair and a long white beard frame a fierce upward-looking face. Red cloak and layered armor wrap the shoulders and torso, with worn metal pieces and a heavy belt catching small highlights. One broad sword rises diagonally toward the upper right, its pale blade cutting sharply across the rust-colored cave. The other hand braces near the waist, adding tension to the compact posture. At the lower left, a small brown animal stands on the same ledge, partly in shadow and turned toward the center. The foreground rock breaks into gray-green slabs and a short patch of pale grass, then falls away into darkness at the bottom edge. Fine brushwork gives the beard, metal fittings, and sword edge clarity, while broader, rougher marks turn the stone into a smoky backdrop. Warm light from the right and behind catches the cloak, face, and blade; cool gray shadow remains beneath the ledge and under the body. Russet, ember orange, dark umber, muted green, and silver make a dramatic but coherent palette. The overall composition places a small heroic silhouette against a vast burning cavern, with the sword providing the decisive upward thrust.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形幻想油画式图像描绘一名身形敦实的留须战士站在岩台上，洞穴内泛橙红光。上方背景是被火光照亮的粗糙石壁，凹处深棕，凸脊带暖亮。战士占据中央，从略低视点观看，一只靴子向前踏，身体转向右侧。浓密浅发和长白胡须框住一张凶猛仰望的脸。红斗篷与层叠甲衣包裹肩和躯干，磨旧金属件及厚腰带接住细小亮光。一柄宽剑斜升向右上，浅色剑刃鲜明切过锈色洞穴。另一只手支在腰附近，为紧凑姿势加入张力。左下方一只小棕色动物立在同一岩台上，部分在阴影中，转向中央。前景岩石裂成灰绿石板和一小片浅草，然后在下缘落入黑暗。细笔触让胡须、金属配件与剑边清楚，较宽较粗的笔痕使石壁成为烟雾般背景。来自右侧和后方的暖光照亮斗篷、面部和剑身；岩台下和身体底部保留冷灰阴影。赭红、余烬橙、深褐、柔绿与银色组成戏剧性却连贯的色域。整体构图把小而英勇的剪影置于广阔燃烧洞穴前，让剑成为决定性的向上冲力。
style_prompt_en: The image has a dramatic fantasy-painting finish, with carefully modeled focal forms set against broad rough atmospheric masses. Ember orange, rust, dark umber, muted moss, and silver create a warm field cut by cool shadow. Hard pale diagonals and bright raised edges concentrate action, while surrounding contours dissolve into smoky brushwork. Small metal-like glints and tactile worn surfaces enrich the central cluster without flattening the larger value pattern. Directional warm backlight rims projecting forms, and cool under-shadows give them weight. A compact foreground mass stands against a much larger turbulent background, establishing heroic scale. The overall effect is forceful, textured, and mythic.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有戏剧性幻想绘画质感，细心塑造的焦点形体立在宽阔粗糙的大气块面前。余烬橙、锈色、深褐、柔苔绿与银色形成被冷影切开的暖色域。坚硬浅色斜线和受光凸缘集中动作，周围轮廓消融进烟雾般笔触。小型似金属闪点与可触磨旧表面丰富中央聚块，却不压平大明度结构。定向暖背光勾亮伸出的形体，冷色底影赋予重量。紧凑前景体量对着更大而动荡的背景，建立英雄式尺度。整体效果有力、富肌理且带神话感。
theme_en: A bearded warrior raising a sword on a rocky ledge in a fiery cavern
theme_zh: 火红洞穴中岩台上举剑的留须战士
name: Jeff Easley
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
